STS1_BERSERK.description:
Gain {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
STS1_BERSERK.title: Berserk
STS1_BLOOD_FOR_BLOOD.description:
Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each time you lose HP this combat.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
STS1_BLOOD_FOR_BLOOD.title: Blood for Blood
STS1_BRUTALITY.description: At the start of your turn, lose 1 HP and draw 1 card.
STS1_BRUTALITY.title: Brutality
STS1_CARNAGE.title: Carnage
STS1_CLEAVE.title: Cleave
STS1_CLOTHESLINE.title: Clothesline
STS1_COMBUST.description: At the end of your turn, lose 1 HP and deal {Sts1CombustPower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
STS1_COMBUST.title: Combust
STS1_DISARM.title: Disarm
STS1_DOUBLE_TAP.description: This turn, your next {Attacks:plural:Attack is|{Attacks:diff()} Attacks are} played twice.
STS1_DOUBLE_TAP.title: Double Tap
STS1_DROPKICK.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the enemy is [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} card.
STS1_DROPKICK.title: Dropkick
STS1_EVOLVE.description: Whenever you draw a [gold]Status[/gold] card, draw {Sts1EvolvePower:diff()} {Sts1EvolvePower:plural:card|cards}.
STS1_EVOLVE.title: Evolve
STS1_EXHUME.description: Put a card from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
STS1_EXHUME.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to put into your Hand.
STS1_EXHUME.title: Exhume
STS1_FIRE_BREATHING.description: Whenever you draw a [gold]Status[/gold] or [gold]Curse[/gold] card, deal {Sts1FireBreathingPower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
STS1_FIRE_BREATHING.title: Fire Breathing
STS1_FLEX.description:
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
At the end of this turn, lose {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
STS1_FLEX.title: Flex
STS1_GHOSTLY_ARMOR.title: Ghostly Armor
STS1_HEAVY_BLADE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
[gold]Strength[/gold] affects this card {Multiplier:diff()} times.
STS1_HEAVY_BLADE.title: Heavy Blade
STS1_IMMOLATE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Add a [gold]Burn[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
STS1_IMMOLATE.title: Immolate
STS1_INTIMIDATE.title: Intimidate
STS1_JUGGERNAUT.description: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], deal {JuggernautPower:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
STS1_JUGGERNAUT.title: Juggernaut
STS1_LIMIT_BREAK.title: Limit Break
STS1_METALLICIZE.description: At the end of your turn, gain {Sts1MetallicizePower:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
STS1_METALLICIZE.title: Metallicize
STS1_POWER_THROUGH.title: Power Through
STS1_PUMMEL.title: Pummel
STS1_RAMPAGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Increase this card's damage by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
STS1_RAMPAGE.title: Rampage
STS1_REAPER.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Heal HP equal to unblocked damage.
STS1_REAPER.title: Reaper
STS1_RECKLESS_CHARGE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Shuffle a [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
STS1_RECKLESS_CHARGE.title: Reckless Charge
STS1_RUPTURE.description: Whenever you lose HP from a card, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
STS1_RUPTURE.title: Rupture
STS1_SEARING_BLOW.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Can be [gold]Upgraded[/gold] any number of times.
STS1_SEARING_BLOW.title: Searing Blow
STS1_SEEING_RED.title: Seeing Red
STS1_SENTINEL.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If this card is [gold]Exhausted[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
STS1_SENTINEL.title: Sentinel
STS1_SEVER_SOUL.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] all non-Attack cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
STS1_SEVER_SOUL.title: Sever Soul
STS1_SPOT_WEAKNESS.description: If the enemy intends to attack, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
STS1_SPOT_WEAKNESS.title: Spot Weakness
STS1_WARCRY.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Put 1 card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
STS1_WARCRY.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose a card to put on top of your Draw Pile.
STS1_WARCRY.title: Warcry
STS1_WILD_STRIKE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Shuffle a [gold]Wound[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
STS1_WILD_STRIKE.title: Wild Strike
